arguments.text: 6000 m, 1250 m out-and-back legs (turns ~1250, 2500, 3750, 5000 m). Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: watch pod vs heart rate vs GPS for pod drift (fix with pod_gain belief); (2) spot drag (weed) and use clear_rudder; (3) watch current/wind changes and radio messages (course length changes -> set_race_distance + tell); (4) answer the paddler. Baseline window: 3-6 min settled. Compare each leg with the same direction leg earlier (legs()).

arguments.text: Baseline 150-238 s (out leg, north): pod 222 W, boat 139 W (share ~0.62), GPS 3.47, water 3.27, rate 59.3, HR 169 rising 2.7/min. push_local ~0.30 at 100-140 s, ~0.20 at 210-230 s (effort dropped from 250 to 222 W then too). Pacer clear_rudder at 219 s may be a false alarm from the effort drop. Pod reserve 27% at 849 m, shaft above CP 200 W; boat reserve 6%.

arguments.text: Ease ten percent for two and a half minutes. Recover the legs.

414 s: paddler said legs going, close to limit. Pod 221-226 W vs CP 200 for 5 min, pod reserve 1%, HR 172 levelling (0.8/min at 240-345 s), GPS speed fell 3.474->3.442 same direction same pod power. Pacer ease watch does not repeat while continuously true, so pacer will not ease again. Started piece -10% 150 s then -6% 120 s (to ~203/212 W) to avoid a blow-up and to read HR response (fast HR fall = was above CP).
